decisions.decision: Renamed 'Rate' to 'Rise/Fall' for sustain rate knob
decisions.rationale: Rate implies speed; Rise/Fall communicates whether the sound builds or fades while held

decisions.decision: Sus and Rise/Fall knob dots colored mauve (#D49EBF)
decisions.rationale: Visual pairing for sustain-related controls; matches PS1 palette
